version.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

llm.summary: This is a disclosed Canva integration that relies on the ClawLink plugin and OAuth, with no hidden or malicious behavior found.

dimensions.detail: Networked OAuth through ClawLink and Canva API access are proportionate to the integration purpose, but users are trusting an external service and live tool catalog.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs installation and allowlisting of the ClawLink plugin and a gateway restart after user confirmation; the plugin identifier is not pinned to an immutable version or digest.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions require discovery before use, preview and confirmation before writes, and explicit confirmation for destructive or team-wide brand-template changes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The plugin installation, allowlist change, gateway restart, and ClawLink OAuth token storage are persistent effects, but they are disclosed and tied to the skill's purpose.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to create, manage, export, and upload Canva content; the described Canva read/write capabilities match that purpose and are disclosed.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you trust ClawLink to mediate Canva access, review the Canva permissions granted during OAuth, and be aware that the plugin install and allowlist change persist beyond the current chat.
llm.findings: [T08] unexpected: The artifact does install a third-party plugin without a pinned version or digest, which is a real supply-chain consideration, but the behavior is disclosed, user-confirmed, and purpose-aligned; no malicious payload or deceptive instruction was present in the inspected artifact.
